_note: Per-channel defaults for studio.py, so the handle and house style are set once here instead of retyped on every run. Command-line flags still override.
_fonts: font = captions and watermark, title_font = the title. Keep a proportional face for captions: a fixed-cell pixel face such as Press Start 2P is about one em per character, so caption lines get shrunk hard to fit. char_width_ratio is only consulted when Pillow is missing and text cannot be measured -- set it to 1.0 if you point font at a pixel face and have no Pillow.
